rules_of_thumb: Uniformitarianism: "the present is the key to the past", within the range of present processes. Fails for impacts and for early-Earth conditions.
Water flows downhill. Fails in a pumped aquifer.
Contour V's point upstream. Fails at an overhang or karst.
Tobler's first law: near things are more related than distant things. Fails across barriers.
collisions: A landform process is one claim, filed at EA.O.A4.1. The rock record of it is EA.O.A3. The equation is not filed twice.
GIS and cartography are methods (EA.M.4). GIScience is a bridge (EA.B.C8), not a claim about the Earth.
A fossil's biology is BI.O.A4.5. Its occurrence in a stratum is EA.O.A3.5.
Physical laws of fluids and radiation are PH. The dated state and circulation of ocean, atmosphere and ice are EA.O.A4.3–A4.4.
Decay law N = N₀e^(−λt) is PH. The age it gives under closure is EA.O.A3.3. Pharmacokinetic and first-order chemical half-lives are MD and CH; the registry disambiguates.

Element distribution in Earth reservoirs is EA.O.A1.5. Speciation in a natural matrix is CH. Each cites the other.
Soil body and horizons are EA.O.A4.5. Effective stress and Mohr–Coulomb are EN.

Risk = hazard × exposure × vulnerability is EA.O.A5.5. The hazard cites A2 or A4.
